profile.headline: Workday Integrations Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary: Mark Bryan Ramirez started working as a Workday Integration Consultant after he received his certification last February 2014. Since then, Mark has been into multiple successful Workday implementation/support projects in which he provides his expertise in design, development and support of integration systems in Workday. Mark is experienced and proficient in using integration tools like Workday Studio, EIBs, Document Transformation, Core Connectors, Payroll Interface, etc. Mark is also capable of leading a team of Workday Integration Consultants and has worked well in interacting with clients to perform requirements gathering, analysis, status updates, design/code reviews, and client demos in an Agile or Waterfall methodology.
